Tomorrow at Habibi Downtown Radio.

A live session in two movements.

First, Hedi Fahem on guitar and Hsin Benmiloud on nay and kawala come together for an ambient journey, blending strings, breath and textures into an intimate, immersive soundscape.

In the second movement, HABIIIBIJI joins them, bringing electronic layers, hypnotic rhythms and deeper grooves into the mix.

From ambient explorations to a more groove-driven live experience, let the sounds unfold.

Hedi Fahem is a Tunisian guitarist and composer exploring the intersection of contemporary guitar,
electronic textures and cinematic soundscapes.
Active as a performer, session guitarist, composer and jazz guitar teacher at ISM, his work moves between
live performance, studio collaborations and original soundtracks for Films/series blending organic
guitar expression with immersive sound design, focusing on space, texture and emotion.

THE ARTIST
CHEB REZGUI
THE VOICE BEHIND ANA AL GHALTAN
Born Mohamed Resgui in Casablanca, Morocco,
on June 19, 1976, Cheb Rezgui discovered music at a
very young age, singing at school from the age of seven.
Inspired by the voices of Cheb Khaled and Cheb Mami,
he developed his own musical path and began
his artistic career in 1994.
His music would soon find its way across borders, making
him one of the memorable voices of the Moroccan rai scene.

texte:
Zanzana Revival, lundi 23 novembre au Habibi Downtown, Tunis 🤘

De 2000 à 2010, puis de 2015 à 2020, ZanZanA a été l'émission rock et metal à la radio. Lundi, je la fais revivre derrière les platines.

Au programme : Led Zeppelin et Hendrix, la scène tunisienne et arabe avec Myrath, Carthagods, Hemlyn et Znous, les hymnes de Maiden, AC/DC et Metallica, une séquence rap metal, une séquence indus avec Rammstein, et un final à chanter 🔥

Tu écoutais l'émission ? Viens, et ramène ceux qui l'écoutaient avec toi.

Portes à 17h, musique de 20h à 00h30, entrée libre. 49 avenue Habib Bourguiba 🎸

#ZanzanaRevival #ZanzanaMetal #MetalTunisie #HabibiDowntown
